title: Capital
description: YOU CAN SELL AND BUY ANYTHING YOU WANT!!! Clientside
body:
YOU CAN SELL AND BUY EVERYTHING!!!
This mod allows you to buy and sell items through a custom graphical interface.
This mod runs client-side and does not require server installation.
All actions are performed using the /give (give an item) and /clear (remove an item) commands from your inventory.
This mod requires operator permissions on the server.
To access the shop, approach a workbench and right-click on it (hold Shift). This will open a menu where you can search for any item (and sell or buy it).
The price is displayed in a 4/2 format (where 4 is the price at which you can buy the item, and 2 is the price at which you can sell it).
There is also a price menu where you can view and estimate the value of a specific item in your inventory.

The Bulk Buy menu allows you to select the slots you want to sell, and on the side, you'll see detailed information about how much each item will cost (and, of course, a "Sell" button).
The ATM menu allows you to exchange coins for larger or smaller ones, as well as deposit or withdraw funds from your virtual balance.
Additionally, typing "v2000" in chat will add 2000 coins to your virtual balance. Typing "s2000" in chat will withdraw funds from your virtual account.

Coins are essentially standard items, simply with custom names and textures. To other players without this mod, they will appear as normal items:
Coin 1 - Brick
Coin 5 - Rabbit's Foot
Coin 10 - Prismarine
Coin 50 - Honeycomb
Coin 100 - Record Fragment
Coin 500 - Heart of the Sea
Coin 1000 - Echo Shard
Coin 5000 - Enchanted Golden Apple
Coin 10000 - Nether Star

The mod includes 3 modes (you can Select only once at the beginning):
Easy - commission approximately 20% (difference between buying and selling)
Normal - commission approximately 50% (difference between buying and selling) + some prices are adjusted to prevent abuse
Hardcore - commission approximately 50% (difference between buying and selling) + dynamic prices (item price changes depending on the number of purchases or sales) + daily limit (Minecraft-like) for selling
commission is always at least 1 coin, commission is always rounded up

The mod is still in the Beta testing and development stage, so there may be bugs in the GUI.
